reviews.text: Welcome to Muszynova – a place where elegance meets exquisite taste. Enjoy delicious dishes, from juicy burgers to exquisite tartares and sweet desserts, paired with refreshing drinks. Our polite service and calm atmosphere will make every visit a moment of relaxation and pleasure. Spend a lovely afternoon with your loved ones and discover why our guests keep coming back for more!

1.name: Mariolka Pyrz
1.text: A very elegant restaurant. Delicious tartar, very good pizzas, and excellent desserts. A very nice place to relax. Highly recommend 👍

2.name: Amelia
2.text: The service was polite and always smiling, creating a nice atmosphere. The place is calm, perfect for relaxation. The burger was delicious and juicy, and the Aperol refreshing and perfectly balanced.

3.name: Beata Sękowska
3.text: A great place to spend a lovely afternoon with friends. Very good drinks. Pleasant service.

4.name: AK K.
4.text: A beautiful and new playroom for small and medium-sized children, there’s even a nursing room and changing tables! Great value and a nice interior.

5.name: Bolek Lolek
5.text: Delicious schnitzel. Overall, a very well-maintained and clean place. Climbing wall, kids' room, game room, everything is new.

6.name: Monika Sam
6.text: A fantastic new place with friendly people, very nice service, and cleanliness throughout the building. The gym is well-equipped, and the trainers are helpful. Highly recommend. 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩

7.name: Magda Thomas
7.text: The latest local gem. Very nice, friendly atmosphere. Professional service, great instructors. Interesting offer and affordable prices. Definitely worth visiting regularly.

skocznia.text: The cottages are entirely made of wood, which lets you experience and feel the mountain atmosphere. Each cottage is centrally heated, has a fully equipped kitchenette with a relaxation area, and two separate bedrooms.

wierszyki.text: An undeniable advantage of the shelter is its location, which will delight both tourists wanting to spend time on the famous Krupówki Street and those who prefer several-hour hikes away from the hustle and bustle.

elzbiecina.text: Elżbiecina Villa – the former Korfanty residence, is a unique blend of history, design, Zakopane-style architecture, and the omnipresent Witkacy-inspired Zakopane spirit.

rentplanet.text: Innovative methods and tools are used to automate many booking processes. Thanks to this, guest service in the apartment becomes simpler, and many actions take place practically without human involvement.

nosal.text: Mornings with a view of the mountain range are a ready-made recipe for a good mood all day long. Traditional Podhale cuisine is the hallmark of our original restaurant Dym i Wiatr.

klimatyczne.text: Atmospheric Cottages are very comfortable cottages built with those in mind who are looking for a place with a warm, friendly vibe conducive to relaxation.

patryk.text: Villa “Patryk” is located in a quiet and peaceful area, with plenty of greenery and walking trails nearby that encourage active rest. We especially recommend the trail to Gubałówka, the Jan Kasprowicz trail through Bachledzki Wierch, and others.
